title: Articles
subtitle: a, an, the, and when we use no article

rows.example: I need to get **a** new coat.

rows.use: an · instead of a when the next word begins with a vowel sound
rows.example: I don't have enough money for **an** expensive dress.

blocks.text: Whether we use **a** or **an** with a word depends on the **sound**, not the spelling.

rows.example: Let's go to **the** new shopping centre.
I gave the shop assistant **the** money and then left.
Prices have gone up a lot recently.
Fresh fruit is really good for you.

seas (**the** Atlantic), rivers (**the** Amazon), areas (**the** Antarctic), some countries (**the** USA, **the** UK), public buildings (**the** theatre), **the** Earth, **the** world, **the** sky, **the** moon, **the** sun, **the** sea, **the** environment
towns and cities (Moscow), most countries (France), continents (Europe), streets (Baker Street), planets (Mars)
go to work, on TV, go shopping, play tennis, listen to music, go to school, be at school, be at university, school subjects (maths)

become king, he's English, speak English

exercises.title: A · a, an or the
exercises.instruction: Complete using a, an or the.

items.prompt: We had ___ really good science lesson at school today.
I found ___ unusual insect on the wall outside our house.
It's your birthday next week. Are you going to have ___ party?
We waited for hours, but we finally saw ___ Queen.
Why don't we listen to ___ radio?
Have you got ___ euro I could borrow?
Mum has gone to ___ bank, but she'll be back soon.
Where have you been? I've been waiting for over ___ hour!

exercises.title: B · Article or dash
exercises.instruction: Write an article in each gap where necessary. If an article is not necessary, put a dash (-).

items.prompt: I had (1) ___ really bad day on Tuesday.
I had a really bad day on (2) ___ Tuesday.
I bought (3) ___ new game on CD-ROM for my computer,
but (4) ___ game didn't work properly.
I took it back to (5) ___ shop on
(6) ___ North Street, but
(7) ___ manager blamed me!
He pointed to (8) ___ scratch on
(9) ___ CD-ROM and said I'd done it.
I couldn't believe it! I had to buy (10) ___ new one!

exercises.title: C · Extra word
exercises.instruction: Write the extra word in each sentence. If the sentence is already correct, write OK.

items.prompt: Do you think we will ever send a person to **the** Mars?
When you go to **the** London, don't forget to see the London Eye.
When we use **the** cars, we damage the environment.
I'm not telling a lies! It's the truth.
I'm looking for a teacher who can teach me **the** German.
Ray needs a warm hat and a new coat for his visit to **the** Russia.
Dad has gone to **a** work and forgotten the car keys.
Some people have an unusual pets, such as lions or tigers.

exercises.title: D · Missing word
exercises.instruction: Write the missing article (and the word after it if you need to show the place).

items.prompt: English music was popular in America in **1960s**.
Would you prefer to read **book** or watch television?
We had maths at school yesterday and our teacher gave us **surprise test**!
Peter joined **police** and caught ten thieves in his first month!
Gordon wanted to be **writer**, so he studied English at university.
Suddenly, two UFOs appeared in **sky** over Washington.

exercises.title: E · Add articles
exercises.instruction: Rewrite the sentences correctly, adding articles where necessary.

items.prompt: We had great time in USA.
acceptedAnswers: We had a great time in the USA.
We had a great time in the USA

items.prompt: Let's go to Belgium for week this summer.
acceptedAnswers: Let's go to Belgium for a week this summer.
Let's go to Belgium for a week this summer

items.prompt: Where's money I gave you on fifteenth of last month?
acceptedAnswers: Where's the money I gave you on the fifteenth of last month?
Where's the money I gave you on the fifteenth of last month

items.prompt: I'd like to join army and become soldier.
acceptedAnswers: I'd like to join the army and become a soldier.
I'd like to join the army and become a soldier
I would like to join the army and become a soldier.
I would like to join the army and become a soldier

items.prompt: For Christmas, I got book, DVD and latest CD by my favourite band.
acceptedAnswers: For Christmas, I got a book, a DVD and the latest CD by my favourite band.
For Christmas, I got a book, a DVD and the latest CD by my favourite band

items.prompt: They say that English drink lot of tea.
acceptedAnswers: They say that the English drink a lot of tea.
They say that the English drink a lot of tea

items.prompt: I heard song on radio that I really liked.
acceptedAnswers: I heard a song on the radio that I really liked.
I heard a song on the radio that I really liked

items.prompt: Do Japanese and other people in Asia eat cheese?
acceptedAnswers: Do the Japanese and other people in Asia eat cheese?
Do the Japanese and other people in Asia eat cheese

exercises.title: F · Dialogue mistakes
exercises.instruction: Tap the article that is wrong, then write the correct form. Use a dash (-) if the article should be removed.
exercises.paragraph: {click:It's the} lovely day, isn't it? Let's walk down to {click:a shops} and look around. That's {click:an good} idea. I'll just have a look {click:in a kitchen} and see what we need. I got {click:a milk} yesterday, so we don't need any more. We might need {click:a bread}, though. Okay. Bread … oh, and {click:the packet} of sugar. After shopping, we could go to {click:a new market} in {click:a town centre} and see what they have. Right. You get your coat and I'll get {click:a car keys}.

items.prompt: Opening line
items.explanation: First mention of a lovely day uses a, not the.

items.prompt: Shops in general / the local shops
items.explanation: Plural shops needs the (specific local shops) or no article for shops in general. Write: the shops

items.prompt: Sound before a consonant
items.explanation: good begins with a consonant sound → a good.

items.prompt: Their kitchen
items.explanation: A specific kitchen in the house uses the.

items.prompt: Uncountable milk
items.explanation: Milk is uncountable here. Write: some milk or -

items.prompt: Uncountable bread
items.explanation: Bread is uncountable unless you mean a loaf.

A known local market
items.explanation: If you mean the town's market, use the.
